query: Audit our Figma design-token library end to end, establish a baseline, and do not change anything until each cleanup pass is previewed and approved.
We have last month's token audit and a new Figma snapshot. Coordinate a safe baseline comparison and tell us which supported fix pass should come next.
Inspect this exported Figma variable JSON read-only. Report collections, modes, aliases, naming problems, coverage, and everything you could not observe.
Create a machine-comparable current-state report for our token library from the MCP data, including a validated canonical snapshot and audit JSON.
Review the scopes in our validated Figma token scan. Find ALL_SCOPES values and scopes that are too broad, too narrow, or incompatible with the variable type.
Our typography and accessibility variables have unusual scopes. Use the latest audit to classify safe proposals and high-risk holds without changing them.
Find semantic token gaps across disabled, selected, hover, pressed, focus, warning, and error states. Do not create any variables.
Several button and navigation components still use primitive colors and detached spacing values. Determine which recurring intents are real semantic gaps.
Gap DTA-GAP-014 was accepted. Prepare the exact Figma variable proposal with collection, modes, aliases, scopes, description, changelog, reference card, and verification.
Propose a disabled foreground semantic token from the accepted gap record and latest validated scan. Show the exact approval preview but create nothing yet.
Implement these design-token constants in our TypeScript theme and update the React components that consume them.
Build a new Button component and its variants in Figma using our existing design system variables.
Run an accessibility review of this checkout screen, including contrast, focus order, keyboard navigation, and screen-reader labels.
Rename these CSS custom properties throughout the repository and update all imports.
Delete unused Sass variables after checking references in the codebase.
Design a fresh color palette for our wellness brand and show accessible color combinations.
Explain in simple terms how Figma variable modes work. I am not asking for an audit.
Convert this Tokens Studio export to Style Dictionary format for Android and iOS builds.
Add one release note to our existing token changelog; no token inspection is needed.
Check whether this JSON file is syntactically valid and pretty-print it.
Bind these seven Figma node properties to the existing variables identified by the validated token audit. Preview every node and property before writing.
Rebind this component fill from the wrong semantic variable to the approved existing variable, with drift checks and independent verification.
Explain conceptually what a variable binding in Figma is; do not inspect or modify a file.
Before binding this FLOAT opacity token, compare its resolved consumer value with the disabled button's effective opacity and hold any scale mismatch.
Correct the existing local Figma variable opacity/disabled in one mode after showing consumer impact, exact rollback, and an approval preview.
A variable has the wrong alias target in Dark mode. Prepare a separately approved value-fix pass with cycle checks and rollback.
Change this JavaScript constant from 0.45 to 0.5 in the application source code.
Extend the Figma token changelog and reference cards safely without overlapping wrapped rows, then verify the complete documentation area.
Audit the changelog and reference frames for layout structure, clipped content, overlap, and complete-area screenshot evidence without changing them.
Resume my Figma token audit and show a visual high-level dashboard with where I am, what is complete, and the single next action.
Validate this design-token workflow-state.json and reconcile it with the latest audit before continuing.
Scan every observable Figma component property for recurring hardcoded values, including literals that match no current variable, without creating tokens.
Determine whether empty Figma variable scope arrays mean unrestricted use; do not assume they are ALL_SCOPES.
Audit every variable-bindable node property supported by the Figma adapter and prove eligible versus inspected coverage, including opacity and unmatched literals.
Check ordinary Figma layer rotation and blend modes for visual consistency without treating them as variable-binding candidates.
